CustomField.description: Total allocation across assignments with no end date. A validation rule blocks it from exceeding 100. Under 100 means a team member left without a new split; processing routes those trades to review. Display and validation only: processing calculates the split in effect on each trade date.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Should equal 100%. If it is lower, someone's share needs to be reassigned before trades can load.
CustomField.label: Active Allocation Total
